STORE_NAME.LABEL: Store Name
STORE_NAME.HELP: The name shown in the browser tab, emails, and receipts.
STORE_NAME.TOOLTIP: Appears across the storefront, admin, and outgoing emails. Applies immediately, no restart needed.

STORE_DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Store Description
STORE_DESCRIPTION.HELP: A short summary used for search engines and social sharing.
STORE_DESCRIPTION.TOOLTIP: Shown in search results and link previews. Doesn't affect any on-page content.

CONTACT_EMAIL.LABEL: Contact Email
CONTACT_EMAIL.HELP: The main email address customers can reach you at.
CONTACT_EMAIL.TOOLTIP: Shown on public pages such as the footer and contact page. Not used for sending mail — see Email settings for that.

SUPPORT_EMAIL.LABEL: Support Email
SUPPORT_EMAIL.HELP: The email address used for customer support requests.
SUPPORT_EMAIL.TOOLTIP: Shown wherever the storefront links to support. Separate from Contact Email so you can route them differently.

PHONE.LABEL: Phone
PHONE.HELP: A public phone number, if you have one.
PHONE.TOOLTIP: Optional. Shown on the storefront if provided.

ADDRESS.LABEL: Address
ADDRESS.HELP: Your business address, if you display one publicly.
ADDRESS.TOOLTIP: Optional. Shown on the storefront and in legal pages.

TIMEZONE.LABEL: Timezone
TIMEZONE.HELP: Used for scheduling and displaying dates in the admin.
TIMEZONE.TOOLTIP: Affects report dates, scheduled promotions, and audit timestamps shown to admins. Doesn't change stored data, only how times are displayed.

DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Default Language
DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.HELP: The language shown to new visitors before they pick one.
DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.TOOLTIP: Applies to first-time visitors only — returning customers keep their own language preference. Takes effect immediately.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY.LABEL: Default Currency
DEFAULT_CURRENCY.HELP: The currency used for displaying prices to new visitors.
DEFAULT_CURRENCY.TOOLTIP: Prices are always stored in USD internally — this only changes what's displayed. Takes effect immediately, no restart needed.

STORE_STATUS.LABEL: Store Status
STORE_STATUS.HELP: Controls whether the storefront is open for browsing and purchases.
STORE_STATUS.TOOLTIP: Affects every customer immediately. "Temporarily Closed" is different from Maintenance Mode — it's a lighter, storefront-only state.

LOGO_URL.LABEL: Logo URL
LOGO_URL.HELP: The main logo shown in the storefront header.
LOGO_URL.TOOLTIP: Applies immediately across the storefront. Use a transparent PNG or SVG for best results.

FAVICON_URL.LABEL: Favicon URL
FAVICON_URL.HELP: The small icon shown in browser tabs.
FAVICON_URL.TOOLTIP: Some browsers cache favicons — customers may need to hard-refresh to see a change.

ADMIN_LOGO_URL.LABEL: Admin Logo URL
ADMIN_LOGO_URL.HELP: The logo shown inside the admin dashboard, separate from the storefront.
ADMIN_LOGO_URL.TOOLTIP: Only visible to staff signed into the admin — customers never see this one.

PRIMARY_COLOR.LABEL: Primary Color
PRIMARY_COLOR.HELP: Your main brand color, used for buttons and highlights.
PRIMARY_COLOR.TOOLTIP: Applies across the storefront immediately. Aim for enough contrast against white and dark backgrounds.

SECONDARY_COLOR.LABEL: Secondary Color
SECONDARY_COLOR.HELP: A supporting color used alongside the primary color.
SECONDARY_COLOR.TOOLTIP: Used for secondary UI elements and text accents.

ACCENT_COLOR.LABEL: Accent Color
ACCENT_COLOR.HELP: A highlight color for badges, tags, and small details.
ACCENT_COLOR.TOOLTIP: Used sparingly for emphasis — badges, notification dots, small callouts.

FOOTER_LOGO_URL.LABEL: Footer Logo URL
FOOTER_LOGO_URL.HELP: An optional alternate logo shown in the storefront footer.
FOOTER_LOGO_URL.TOOLTIP: Leave blank to reuse the main logo in the footer.

BROWSER_TITLE.LABEL: Browser Title
BROWSER_TITLE.HELP: The default page title shown in browser tabs.
BROWSER_TITLE.TOOLTIP: Individual pages (products, categories) may override this with their own title.

DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Default Language
DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.HELP: The language new visitors see by default.
DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.TOOLTIP: Same setting as in General — shown here for convenience alongside other localization options.

SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.LABEL: Supported Languages
SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.HELP: Languages customers can switch the storefront to.
SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.TOOLTIP: HAMBOX currently ships English and Arabic translations — removing a language here hides its switcher option immediately.

RTL_ENABLED.LABEL: RTL Layout Enabled
RTL_ENABLED.HELP: Enables right-to-left layout when Arabic is selected.
RTL_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Only affects the Arabic locale. Turning this off shows Arabic text in a left-to-right layout, which is unusual — leave it on unless you have a specific reason.

BASE_CURRENCY.LABEL: Base Currency
BASE_CURRENCY.HELP: The currency all prices are ultimately calculated from.
BASE_CURRENCY.TOOLTIP: All prices are stored in USD internally regardless of this setting — this only affects the reference currency for rate calculations.

SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.LABEL: Supported Currencies
SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.HELP: Currencies customers can view prices in.
SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES.TOOLTIP: Removing a currency here hides it from the customer currency switcher immediately.

EXCHANGE_RATE_REFRESH_MINUTES.LABEL: Exchange Rate Refresh
EXCHANGE_RATE_REFRESH_MINUTES.HELP: How often live exchange rates are refreshed.
EXCHANGE_RATE_REFRESH_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Only applies when the provider below is set to the live exchange rate API.

PROVIDER.LABEL: Rate Provider
PROVIDER.HELP: Choose whether exchange rates are fixed values you set, or fetched live.
PROVIDER.TOOLTIP: Static rates are predictable and never fail; the live API updates automatically but depends on an external service being reachable.

EXTERNAL_API_URL.LABEL: External API URL
EXTERNAL_API_URL.HELP: The exchange rate API endpoint, only used when Provider is set to live rates.
EXTERNAL_API_URL.TOOLTIP: Advanced — only needed if you're using a custom or self-hosted exchange rate provider.

DEFAULT_THEME_ID.LABEL: Default Theme
DEFAULT_THEME_ID.HELP: The theme shown to customers who haven't chosen one.
DEFAULT_THEME_ID.TOOLTIP: Manage the actual look of each theme under Themes in the admin sidebar — this only picks which one is the default.

ALLOW_CUSTOMER_THEME_SWITCH.LABEL: Allow Customer Theme Switching
ALLOW_CUSTOMER_THEME_SWITCH.HELP: Lets customers pick their own light/dark preference.
ALLOW_CUSTOMER_THEME_SWITCH.TOOLTIP: When off, every customer sees the default theme regardless of their device preference.

SYNC_WITH_SYSTEM_PREFERENCE.LABEL: Sync With System Preference
SYNC_WITH_SYSTEM_PREFERENCE.HELP: Automatically matches the customer's device light/dark mode.
SYNC_WITH_SYSTEM_PREFERENCE.TOOLTIP: Only applies when customer theme switching is allowed above.

ENABLED.LABEL: Email Sending Enabled
ENABLED.HELP: Turns outgoing email on or off platform-wide.
ENABLED.TOOLTIP: When off, no order confirmations, password resets, or notifications are sent to anyone. Takes effect immediately.

SENDER_NAME.LABEL: Sender Name
SENDER_NAME.HELP: The name customers see as the sender of your emails.
SENDER_NAME.TOOLTIP: Shown in the recipient's inbox alongside the sender email address.

SENDER_EMAIL.LABEL: Sender Email
SENDER_EMAIL.HELP: The address your emails are sent from.
SENDER_EMAIL.TOOLTIP: Should match or be authorized by the SMTP account below, or emails may be marked as spam.

SMTP_HOST.LABEL: SMTP Host
SMTP_HOST.HELP: The mail server address used to send email.
SMTP_HOST.TOOLTIP: Provided by your email provider (e.g. smtp.gmail.com, smtp.sendgrid.net).

SMTP_PORT.LABEL: SMTP Port
SMTP_PORT.HELP: The port your mail server listens on.
SMTP_PORT.TOOLTIP: Common values are 587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL) — check with your email provider if unsure.

USERNAME.LABEL: SMTP Username
USERNAME.HELP: The username used to authenticate with your mail server.
USERNAME.TOOLTIP: Usually your full email address or an API key, depending on your provider.

PASSWORD.LABEL: SMTP Password
PASSWORD.HELP: The password or API key used to authenticate with your mail server.
PASSWORD.TOOLTIP: Stored encrypted — never shown again once saved. Leave blank to keep the currently stored password.

USE_SSL.LABEL: Use SSL/TLS
USE_SSL.HELP: Encrypts the connection to your mail server.
USE_SSL.TOOLTIP: Almost always should stay on — only disable if your provider explicitly requires an unencrypted connection.

APPLICATION_BASE_URL.LABEL: Application Base URL
APPLICATION_BASE_URL.HELP: The base URL used to build links inside emails.
APPLICATION_BASE_URL.TOOLTIP: Used to construct verification and password reset links — should match your live storefront domain.

VERIFICATION_PATH.LABEL: Verification Path
VERIFICATION_PATH.HELP: The storefront path appended to build email verification links.
VERIFICATION_PATH.TOOLTIP: Advanced — only change if your storefront's verification page has moved.

RESET_PASSWORD_PATH.LABEL: Reset Password Path
RESET_PASSWORD_PATH.HELP: The storefront path appended to build password reset links.
RESET_PASSWORD_PATH.TOOLTIP: Advanced — only change if your storefront's reset-password page has moved.

MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.LABEL: Minimum Password Length
MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.HELP: The shortest password allowed for new accounts.
MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH.TOOLTIP: Applies to new passwords going forward — existing shorter passwords still work until changed.

REQUIRE_NUMBERS.LABEL: Require Numbers
REQUIRE_NUMBERS.HELP: Passwords must contain at least one number.
REQUIRE_NUMBERS.TOOLTIP: Applies to new and changed passwords only.

REQUIRE_SYMBOLS.LABEL: Require Symbols
REQUIRE_SYMBOLS.HELP: Passwords must contain at least one special character.
REQUIRE_SYMBOLS.TOOLTIP: Applies to new and changed passwords only.

REQUIRE_UPPERCASE.LABEL: Require Uppercase
REQUIRE_UPPERCASE.HELP: Passwords must contain at least one uppercase letter.
REQUIRE_UPPERCASE.TOOLTIP: Applies to new and changed passwords only.

SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.LABEL: Session Timeout
SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.HELP: How long a customer stays signed in before needing to log in again.
SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Shorter timeouts are more secure on shared devices; longer timeouts are more convenient. Applies to new sessions.

REMEMBER_ME_DURATION_DAYS.LABEL: Remember Me Duration
REMEMBER_ME_DURATION_DAYS.HELP: How long a "Remember Me" login stays valid.
REMEMBER_ME_DURATION_DAYS.TOOLTIP: Only applies when a customer checks "Remember Me" at login.

ADMIN_OTP_ENABLED.LABEL: Admin OTP Enabled
ADMIN_OTP_ENABLED.HELP: Requires a one-time code for admin logins.
ADMIN_OTP_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Adds a verification step after admin password login. Strongly recommended to keep on for security.

MAX_FAILED_ACCESS_ATTEMPTS.LABEL: Max Failed Login Attempts
MAX_FAILED_ACCESS_ATTEMPTS.HELP: How many failed logins trigger a temporary lockout.
MAX_FAILED_ACCESS_ATTEMPTS.TOOLTIP: Protects against password guessing. Applies to all accounts.

LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES.LABEL: Lockout Duration
LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES.HELP: How long an account stays locked after too many failed attempts.
LOCKOUT_DURATION_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Applies once the failed-attempt limit above is reached.

REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.LABEL: Require Email Verification
REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.HELP: New accounts must verify their email before signing in.
REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.TOOLTIP: Reduces fake accounts. Applies to new registrations going forward.

ENFORCE_HTTPS.LABEL: Enforce HTTPS
ENFORCE_HTTPS.HELP: Requires a secure connection for all traffic.
ENFORCE_HTTPS.TOOLTIP: Turning this off is a security risk — customer data, including passwords, could be sent unencrypted. Only disable for local testing.

CODE_LENGTH.LABEL: Code Length
CODE_LENGTH.HELP: How many digits the one-time verification code has.
CODE_LENGTH.TOOLTIP: Longer codes are more secure but slightly less convenient to type.

EXPIRATION_MINUTES.LABEL: Code Expiration
EXPIRATION_MINUTES.HELP: How long a one-time code stays valid.
EXPIRATION_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Codes expire automatically after this window — the admin will need to request a new one.

MAX_ATTEMPTS.LABEL: Max Attempts
MAX_ATTEMPTS.HELP: How many incorrect code entries are allowed before lockout.

RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.LABEL: Resend Cooldown
RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.HELP: How long an admin must wait before requesting a new code.
RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: Prevents spamming the code delivery method (email/SMS).

LOCKOUT_MINUTES.LABEL: Lockout Duration
LOCKOUT_MINUTES.HELP: How long access is locked after too many failed code attempts.
LOCKOUT_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Applies once the max attempts above is reached.

ENABLED.LABEL: TOTP Enabled
ENABLED.TOOLTIP: An alternative to email/SMS one-time codes, using apps like Google Authenticator.

ARCHITECTURE_READY.LABEL: Architecture Ready
ARCHITECTURE_READY.HELP: Internal readiness flag for the TOTP feature.
ARCHITECTURE_READY.TOOLTIP: Reflects backend readiness — leave as the platform default unless instructed otherwise.

ISSUER.LABEL: Issuer Name
ISSUER.HELP: The name shown inside authenticator apps.
ISSUER.TOOLTIP: Helps admins recognize this account in their authenticator app's list.

DIGITS.LABEL: Digits
DIGITS.HELP: How many digits the authenticator app code has.
DIGITS.TOOLTIP: Standard authenticator apps expect 6 digits — only change if you know your app supports otherwise.

PERIOD_SECONDS.LABEL: Code Refresh Period
PERIOD_SECONDS.HELP: How often the authenticator app code changes.
PERIOD_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: Standard is 30 seconds — most authenticator apps assume this value.

TAX_RATE_PERCENT.LABEL: Tax Rate
TAX_RATE_PERCENT.HELP: The default tax rate applied at checkout.
TAX_RATE_PERCENT.TOOLTIP: Applies platform-wide unless overridden elsewhere. Takes effect on new orders immediately.

SHIPPING_ENABLED_FUTURE.LABEL: Shipping (Reserved)
SHIPPING_ENABLED_FUTURE.HELP: Reserved for a future physical-shipping feature — has no effect yet.
SHIPPING_ENABLED_FUTURE.TOOLTIP: HAMBOX currently sells digital goods only; this toggle isn't wired to any behavior yet.

RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.LABEL: Order Reservation Timeout
RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.HELP: How long items stay reserved for a customer during checkout.
RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: After this window, unpurchased reserved inventory is released back to stock.

ORDER_EXPIRATION_HOURS.LABEL: Order Expiration
ORDER_EXPIRATION_HOURS.HELP: How long an unpaid order stays open before expiring.
ORDER_EXPIRATION_HOURS.TOOLTIP: Expired orders are cancelled automatically by the background worker.

REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS.LABEL: Refund Window
REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS.HELP: How many days after purchase a refund can be requested.
REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS.TOOLTIP: Set to 0 to disable refund requests entirely.

INVOICE_PREFIX.LABEL: Invoice Prefix
INVOICE_PREFIX.HELP: Text shown before the invoice number, e.g. "INV-".
INVOICE_PREFIX.TOOLTIP: Applies to new invoices going forward — existing invoice numbers don't change.

DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_MARGIN_PERCENT.LABEL: Default Supplier Margin
DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_MARGIN_PERCENT.HELP: The default markup applied over a supplier's acquisition cost to compute the storefront price for supplier-fulfilled products.
DEFAULT_SUPPLIER_MARGIN_PERCENT.TOOLTIP: Used unless a specific supplier mapping has its own margin override. Changes apply to new pricing calculations, never to existing orders.

GUEST_CHECKOUT_ALLOWED.LABEL: Allow Guest Checkout
GUEST_CHECKOUT_ALLOWED.HELP: Lets customers buy without creating an account.
GUEST_CHECKOUT_ALLOWED.TOOLTIP: Turning this off requires every customer to register before purchasing — this can reduce conversions.

REQUIRE_PHONE_NUMBER.LABEL: Require Phone Number
REQUIRE_PHONE_NUMBER.HELP: Makes phone number mandatory at checkout.
REQUIRE_PHONE_NUMBER.TOOLTIP: Applies to all checkouts going forward.

DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD.LABEL: Default Payment Method
DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD.HELP: The payment method pre-selected at checkout.
DEFAULT_PAYMENT_METHOD.TOOLTIP: Customers can still choose a different available method if more than one is enabled.

CART_ABANDONMENT_MINUTES.LABEL: Cart Abandonment Window
CART_ABANDONMENT_MINUTES.HELP: How long an inactive cart is considered abandoned.
CART_ABANDONMENT_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Used for abandoned-cart reporting and reminder logic.

DEFAULT_MAX_DISCOUNT_PERCENT.LABEL: Default Max Discount
DEFAULT_MAX_DISCOUNT_PERCENT.HELP: The largest discount percentage a new coupon can offer by default.
DEFAULT_MAX_DISCOUNT_PERCENT.TOOLTIP: A safety ceiling — individual coupons can still be created with a lower discount, and admins with permission can override this per-coupon.

STACK_COUPONS_ALLOWED.LABEL: Allow Stacking Coupons
STACK_COUPONS_ALLOWED.HELP: Lets customers apply more than one coupon to an order.

DEFAULT_COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT.LABEL: Default Usage Limit
DEFAULT_COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT.HELP: How many times a new coupon can be used by default, across all customers.
DEFAULT_COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT.TOOLTIP: Applies only when a new coupon doesn't specify its own limit.

DEFAULT_PER_USER_LIMIT.LABEL: Default Per-Customer Limit
DEFAULT_PER_USER_LIMIT.HELP: How many times a single customer can use a new coupon by default.
DEFAULT_PER_USER_LIMIT.TOOLTIP: Applies only when a new coupon doesn't specify its own limit.

ENABLED.LABEL: Memberships Enabled
ENABLED.HELP: Turns the membership program on or off platform-wide.
ENABLED.TOOLTIP: When off, customers can't subscribe to or view membership plans.

DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS.LABEL: Default Trial Days
DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS.HELP: How many free trial days new membership plans get by default.
DEFAULT_TRIAL_DAYS.TOOLTIP: Set to 0 for no trial. Individual plans can still override this.

AUTO_RENEW_DEFAULT.LABEL: Auto-Renew By Default
AUTO_RENEW_DEFAULT.HELP: Whether new memberships renew automatically unless the customer opts out.
AUTO_RENEW_DEFAULT.TOOLTIP: Applies to new memberships going forward.

ENABLED.LABEL: Referral Program Enabled
ENABLED.HELP: Turns the customer referral program on or off.
ENABLED.TOOLTIP: When off, referral links and rewards stop working immediately for new referrals.

POINTS_PER_REFERRAL.LABEL: Points Awarded Per Successful Referral
POINTS_PER_REFERRAL.HELP: Fixed referral points awarded to the referrer when a referred customer completes their first order.
POINTS_PER_REFERRAL.TOOLTIP: Awarded once per referral, on the referred customer's first completed order.

POINT_VALUE_USD.LABEL: Monetary Value Per Point
POINT_VALUE_USD.HELP: The USD value of one referral point, used to show customers the equivalent dollar value of their points balance.
POINT_VALUE_USD.TOOLTIP: Example: 100 points at $0.10 per point is worth $10.

REWARD_EXPIRY_DAYS.LABEL: Reward Expiry
REWARD_EXPIRY_DAYS.HELP: How many days a referral stays claimable before it expires if the referred customer hasn't completed an order yet.
REWARD_EXPIRY_DAYS.TOOLTIP: Applies to new referrals going forward.

LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD.LABEL: Low Stock Threshold
LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD.HELP: The stock level that triggers a low-stock warning.
LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD.TOOLTIP: Used for admin alerts and dashboard indicators — doesn't block sales by itself.

RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.LABEL: Reservation Timeout
RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.HELP: How long stock stays reserved for a customer during checkout.
RESERVATION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.TOOLTIP: Same concept as the Commerce reservation timeout, applied at the inventory level.

AUTOMATIC_RELEASE_ENABLED.LABEL: Automatic Release
AUTOMATIC_RELEASE_ENABLED.HELP: Automatically returns reserved stock to inventory if a purchase isn't completed.
AUTOMATIC_RELEASE_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Recommended to keep on — otherwise abandoned checkouts can hold stock indefinitely.

CODE_REVEAL_POLICY.LABEL: Code Reveal Policy
CODE_REVEAL_POLICY.HELP: Choose how stock is deducted and codes are shown after purchase.
CODE_REVEAL_POLICY.TOOLTIP: "Manual" requires an admin to release codes by hand — use it if you need a review step before delivery.

WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.LABEL: Worker Interval
WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.HELP: How often the background job worker checks for new work.
WORKER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: Technical setting — lower values process jobs faster but increase database load.

BATCH_SIZE.LABEL: Batch Size
BATCH_SIZE.HELP: How many jobs the worker processes per run.
BATCH_SIZE.TOOLTIP: Technical setting — larger batches process faster but use more memory per run.

MAX_CONCURRENCY.LABEL: Max Concurrency
MAX_CONCURRENCY.HELP: How many jobs can run at the same time.
MAX_CONCURRENCY.TOOLTIP: Technical setting — higher concurrency processes the queue faster but uses more server resources.

VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.LABEL: Visibility Timeout
VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.HELP: How long a job is hidden from other workers while being processed.
VISIBILITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: Technical setting — should be longer than the slowest job normally takes to complete.

RETRY_COUNT.LABEL: Retry Count
RETRY_COUNT.HELP: How many times a failed background job is retried.
RETRY_COUNT.TOOLTIP: Applies to background jobs like email delivery and order fulfillment.

RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS.LABEL: Retry Delay
RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS.HELP: How long to wait before the first retry.
RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: When exponential backoff is on, each retry waits longer than the last, starting from this value.

TIMEOUT_SECONDS.LABEL: Job Timeout
TIMEOUT_SECONDS.HELP: How long a job can run before it's considered failed.
TIMEOUT_SECONDS.TOOLTIP: Technical setting — should be longer than the slowest job normally takes.

DEAD_LETTER_THRESHOLD.LABEL: Dead Letter Threshold
DEAD_LETTER_THRESHOLD.HELP: How many failed attempts before a job is moved aside for manual review.
DEAD_LETTER_THRESHOLD.TOOLTIP: Jobs that exceed this are no longer retried automatically and need admin attention.

USE_EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF.LABEL: Use Exponential Backoff
USE_EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF.HELP: Gradually increases the wait time between retries instead of using a fixed delay.
USE_EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF.TOOLTIP: Recommended — reduces load on failing services instead of retrying rapidly.

EMAIL_ENABLED.LABEL: Email Notifications
EMAIL_ENABLED.HELP: Turns email notifications on or off.
EMAIL_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Also requires Email sending to be enabled under Email settings.

SMS_ENABLED_FUTURE.LABEL: SMS Notifications (Reserved)
SMS_ENABLED_FUTURE.HELP: Reserved for a future SMS notification feature — has no effect yet.
SMS_ENABLED_FUTURE.TOOLTIP: Not yet wired to any SMS provider.

PUSH_ENABLED_FUTURE.LABEL: Push Notifications (Reserved)
PUSH_ENABLED_FUTURE.HELP: Reserved for a future push notification feature — has no effect yet.
PUSH_ENABLED_FUTURE.TOOLTIP: Not yet wired to any push provider.

ADMIN_ALERTS_ENABLED.LABEL: Admin Alerts
ADMIN_ALERTS_ENABLED.HELP: Sends alerts to admins for important platform events.
ADMIN_ALERTS_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Covers general operational alerts, separate from the specific alert types below.

LOW_STOCK_ALERTS_ENABLED.LABEL: Low Stock Alerts
LOW_STOCK_ALERTS_ENABLED.HELP: Notifies admins when inventory drops below the low-stock threshold.
LOW_STOCK_ALERTS_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Uses the threshold configured under Inventory settings.

WORKER_ALERTS_ENABLED.LABEL: Background Worker Alerts
WORKER_ALERTS_ENABLED.HELP: Notifies admins when background jobs fail repeatedly.
WORKER_ALERTS_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Related to the retry and dead-letter settings above.

MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES.LABEL: Max Upload Size
MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES.HELP: The largest file size allowed for uploads.
MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES.TOOLTIP: Applies to product images, branding assets, and other admin uploads.

IMAGE_COMPRESSION_ENABLED.LABEL: Image Compression
IMAGE_COMPRESSION_ENABLED.HELP: Automatically compresses uploaded images to save space.
IMAGE_COMPRESSION_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Recommended on — reduces storage use and improves page load times with minimal visible quality loss.

ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES.LABEL: Allowed File Types
ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES.TOOLTIP: Uploads outside this list are rejected immediately, before being stored.

THUMBNAIL_SMALL_PX.LABEL: Small Thumbnail Size
THUMBNAIL_SMALL_PX.HELP: The pixel size generated for small thumbnails.
THUMBNAIL_SMALL_PX.TOOLTIP: Used in compact listings like search results and cart items.

THUMBNAIL_MEDIUM_PX.LABEL: Medium Thumbnail Size
THUMBNAIL_MEDIUM_PX.HELP: The pixel size generated for medium thumbnails.
THUMBNAIL_MEDIUM_PX.TOOLTIP: Used in product grids and category listings.

THUMBNAIL_LARGE_PX.LABEL: Large Thumbnail Size
THUMBNAIL_LARGE_PX.HELP: The pixel size generated for large thumbnails.

META_TITLE.LABEL: Default Meta Title
META_TITLE.HELP: The fallback page title used for search engines.
META_TITLE.TOOLTIP: Individual pages can override this with their own title.

META_DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Default Meta Description
META_DESCRIPTION.HELP: The fallback description shown in search results.
META_DESCRIPTION.TOOLTIP: Individual pages can override this with their own description.

OPEN_GRAPH_IMAGE_URL.LABEL: Default Social Share Image
OPEN_GRAPH_IMAGE_URL.HELP: The fallback image shown when pages are shared on social media.
OPEN_GRAPH_IMAGE_URL.TOOLTIP: Individual pages can override this with their own image.

TWITTER_CARD_TYPE.LABEL: Twitter/X Card Type
TWITTER_CARD_TYPE.HELP: Controls how links preview when shared on X (Twitter).
TWITTER_CARD_TYPE.TOOLTIP: "Summary with large image" shows a bigger preview image and is usually the better choice for a storefront.

ROBOTS_DIRECTIVE.LABEL: Search Engine Indexing
ROBOTS_DIRECTIVE.HELP: Controls whether search engines index and follow links on your site.
ROBOTS_DIRECTIVE.TOOLTIP: "Don't index" hides your site from search results entirely — only use this intentionally, e.g. on a staging environment.

CANONICAL_BASE_URL.LABEL: Canonical Base URL
CANONICAL_BASE_URL.HELP: Your storefront's official domain, used to avoid duplicate-content issues.
CANONICAL_BASE_URL.TOOLTIP: Should exactly match your live production domain, including https://.

GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID.LABEL: Google Analytics ID
GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID.HELP: Connects your store to Google Analytics.
GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID.TOOLTIP: Leave blank to disable Google Analytics tracking.

GOOGLE_TAG_MANAGER_ID.LABEL: Google Tag Manager ID
GOOGLE_TAG_MANAGER_ID.HELP: Connects your store to Google Tag Manager.
GOOGLE_TAG_MANAGER_ID.TOOLTIP: Leave blank to disable Google Tag Manager.

META_PIXEL_ID.LABEL: Meta Pixel ID
META_PIXEL_ID.HELP: Connects your store to Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel.
META_PIXEL_ID.TOOLTIP: Leave blank to disable Meta Pixel tracking.

ENABLE_TRACKING.LABEL: Enable Tracking
ENABLE_TRACKING.HELP: Master switch for all analytics tracking scripts above.
ENABLE_TRACKING.TOOLTIP: When off, none of the tracking IDs above are loaded, regardless of whether they're filled in.

STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.LABEL: Stripe Publishable Key
STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.HELP: Your Stripe public API key, safe to expose in the browser.
STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.TOOLTIP: The matching secret key is configured on the server and never shown here.

PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID.LABEL: PayPal Client ID
PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID.TOOLTIP: Found in your PayPal developer dashboard.

WEBHOOKS_ENABLED.LABEL: Webhooks Enabled
WEBHOOKS_ENABLED.HELP: Allows payment providers to notify your store of events like successful payments.
WEBHOOKS_ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Recommended on for Stripe/PayPal integrations to stay in sync automatically.

ENABLED.LABEL: Maintenance Mode
ENABLED.HELP: Temporarily disables customer access while administrators continue working.
ENABLED.TOOLTIP: Customers see a "coming soon" style page immediately. Admins can still access the dashboard. No restart required.

MESSAGE.LABEL: Maintenance Message
MESSAGE.HELP: The message shown to customers while maintenance mode is on.
MESSAGE.TOOLTIP: Shown on the maintenance page immediately when maintenance mode is active.

ALLOWED_ROLE_NAMES.LABEL: Roles Allowed During Maintenance
ALLOWED_ROLE_NAMES.HELP: Admin roles that can still browse the storefront while maintenance mode is on.
ALLOWED_ROLE_NAMES.TOOLTIP: Lets your team preview the live site while customers see the maintenance page.

BYPASS_PASSWORD.LABEL: Bypass Password
BYPASS_PASSWORD.HELP: An optional password that lets anyone with it view the site during maintenance.
BYPASS_PASSWORD.TOOLTIP: Owner-only password to unlock the maintenance page. Leave blank to keep the currently stored password.

TERMS_HTML.LABEL: Terms of Service
TERMS_HTML.HELP: The full text of your terms of service page.
TERMS_HTML.TOOLTIP: Supports HTML formatting. Applies immediately to the public terms page.

PRIVACY_HTML.LABEL: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_HTML.HELP: The full text of your privacy policy page.
PRIVACY_HTML.TOOLTIP: Supports HTML formatting. Applies immediately to the public privacy page.

REFUND_POLICY_HTML.LABEL: Refund Policy
REFUND_POLICY_HTML.HELP: The full text of your refund policy page.
REFUND_POLICY_HTML.TOOLTIP: Supports HTML formatting. Applies immediately to the public refund policy page.

SUPPORT_POLICY_HTML.LABEL: Support Policy
SUPPORT_POLICY_HTML.HELP: The full text of your support policy page.
SUPPORT_POLICY_HTML.TOOLTIP: Supports HTML formatting. Applies immediately to the public support policy page.

TITLE.HELP: The main headline shown in the hero banner.
TITLE.TOOLTIP: The largest, most prominent text on your home page.

PRIMARY_BUTTON_TEXT.LABEL: Primary Button Text
PRIMARY_BUTTON_TEXT.HELP: The label on the main call-to-action button.

PRIMARY_BUTTON_URL.LABEL: Primary Button URL
PRIMARY_BUTTON_URL.HELP: Where the main button links to.

SECONDARY_BUTTON_TEXT.LABEL: Secondary Button Text
SECONDARY_BUTTON_TEXT.HELP: The label on the second, less prominent button.

SECONDARY_BUTTON_URL.LABEL: Secondary Button URL
SECONDARY_BUTTON_URL.HELP: Where the secondary button links to.

OVERLAY_IMAGE_URL.LABEL: Overlay Image URL
OVERLAY_IMAGE_URL.HELP: An optional image layered on top of the background.

OVERLAY_OPACITY.LABEL: Overlay Opacity
OVERLAY_OPACITY.HELP: How transparent the overlay image is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).
OVERLAY_OPACITY.TOOLTIP: Higher values make text easier to read over busy background images.

BADGE_TEXT.LABEL: Badge Text
BADGE_TEXT.HELP: A small label shown above the hero title, e.g. "NEW SEASON LIVE".

BUTTON_URL.HELP: Where the banner button links to.

COUNTDOWN_SECONDS.HELP: How long the countdown timer runs for, in seconds.
